text:
Send an email through a configured account without handing callers its password. Submit one message and learn whether it was accepted, partly accepted, refused or unknown; TLS is verified. Start with send.
[destructive] send <to> <subject> <text> [cc] [bcc] [html]: Send one email once and get the outcome: accepted, partial, refused or unknown.
  to (json): Nonempty array of bare ASCII addresses; at most 20 unique across to/cc/bcc
  subject (string): Single line, at most 998 UTF-8 bytes
  text (string): Plain text; total encoded mail at most 1 MiB
  cc (json): Additional visible recipients
  bcc (json): Envelope recipients, omitted from headers
  html (string): HTML alternative; never fetched or rendered here

v<version> · PolyForm-NC · parf.dev/agent-bus/
Docs: https://github.com/parf/ai-agent-bus/blob/main/docs/agents/smtp.md
More: agent-bus help <name> config | secret | json

json.description: Send an email through a configured account without handing callers its password. Submit one message and learn whether it was accepted, partly accepted, refused or unknown; TLS is verified. Start with send.
json.author: Serg Parf

send.help: Send one email once and get the outcome: accepted, partial, refused or unknown.

args.name: to
args.help: Nonempty array of bare ASCII addresses; at most 20 unique across to/cc/bcc

args.name: subject
args.help: Single line, at most 998 UTF-8 bytes

args.name: text
args.help: Plain text; total encoded mail at most 1 MiB

args.name: html
args.help: HTML alternative; never fetched or rendered here

help.help: Show the calls and their limits.

sender.help: Required bare ASCII From/envelope sender; caller cannot override

port.help: Port 1..65535; default 587, use 465 with mode tls

mode.help: Explicit mode; default starttls; plain requires local opt-out

auth.help: password (AUTH PLAIN, default) or Google XOAUTH2; no fallback

recipients.help: Optional exact addresses/domains; [] means all for admitted callers

cafile.help: Optional public CA trust file visible in sandbox; default system trust

allow_plaintext.help: Explicit loopback-only plain/port-25 opt-out; default false

secrets.name: SMTP_USERNAME
secrets.help:
Account name from the provider, in this instance's private smtp/<instance>/env.
Keep package-wide smtp/env free of account credentials when instances differ.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.help: Required with auth=password: app password from the account's security settings.

secrets.name: SMTP_CLIENT_ID
secrets.help: Required with auth=xoauth2: Google's OAuth client ID and secret for your consent app.

secrets.name: SMTP_REFRESH_TOKEN
secrets.help:
Required with auth=xoauth2: obtain through Google's OAuth consent flow with
https://mail.google.com/ scope and offline access. This agent does not open a browser.
